description: This file defines the ExpenseType entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and accessor methods.

classes.name: ExpenseType
classes.description: Entity class representing an expense type used within the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_expense_type' database table with fields for id, name, description, associated user, status, and deletion flag.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the expense type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the expense type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the expense type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the expense type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the expense type.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the expense type.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User entity associated with the expense type.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the expense type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the expense type.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the expense type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the expense type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense type as deleted or restores it.
